additional_info.subject: ID0476918-DC/Si-D/DE- [MULTI] CP1&2 SECC Error CRM:03431000048
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexandra,
Thank you for providing us with logs, and timestamps of the error.
After checking the charger, and the logs in the given timestamp, we see that the charger was unable to connect to the network, and to the car.
Whenever this happens, the car disables charging for safety. After a few moments, the charger could connect again, and the charging session continued.
We hope to have informed you enough. Please provide us with feedback to close the ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
